newsitem.title: BURUNDI: Burundi Franc weakens against dollar, pound.
newsitem.headline: Burundi Franc weakens against dollar, pound.

text.p: The Burundi franc weakened against the dollar and British pound, central bank officials said on Monday.
La Banque de la Republic du Burundi posted a mean commercial rate of 355.9430 against the dollar from 348.7141 on Friday. Against the pound, the franc was posted at a mean of 666.7714 from 570.1761.
In the black market, the franc was exchanging at 550 against the dollar.
Ethnically-divided Burundi is at war between the ruling Tutsi-dominated army and Hutu rebels seeking a greater political stake in the tiny tea and coffee-growing central African nation.
